process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. Big Block: 5 × $10,000 awarded every 50,000 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page, and an eligible winner collects the prize through a conditional claim button shown only when the prize is eligible to be claimed.

key_feature_items.label: Reward Delivery
key_feature_items.copy: Smart contracts issue commissions automatically, while eligible prize winners collect their prize through a conditional claim button.

key_feature_items.label: Yield Generation
key_feature_items.copy: Aave Integration enables the prize pools to accrue yield.

key_feature_items.label: Gamification
key_feature_items.copy: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.

key_feature_items.label: Transparency
key_feature_items.copy: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.

key_feature_items.label: Low Fees
key_feature_items.copy: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

decisions.reason: The source changes how a winner collects a prize, not the Small Block amount, trigger, eligibility, funding, or draw rules; the 100-sale trigger was already current.
Conditional prize claiming does not alter ticket issuance, counters, recipient crediting, or ticket-display consistency.
The source concerns prize collection only and leaves automatic $5 referral-commission payout unchanged.
The prize claim button is unrelated to the NFT-detail View Book action and its ownership-based visibility.
Winner-initiated prize collection does not change VRF selection, eligible population, weighting, fairness, or verification.
The source changes post-draw prize collection rather than code-used ticket issuance or ticket lifecycle rules.
The public pool values and next-draw sales counter remain valid under the conditional claim flow.
The prize collection decision does not change no-referral ticket allocation, recipient selection, or the first-mint exception.
The current hero attributes describe presentation, pricing, commissions, and draw promotion without asserting automatic prize delivery.
